title: Saturday walking in Busan station [4k] |  Busan Bar in South Korea
description:
Busan station is a train station in Busan, South Korea.

this place is also interesting for foreigners because there is also a bar on the street, lots of people have fun here, this bar is always open every night from 8:00 to 10:00 pm because in Korea there is still covid19.  Before there was Covid19, Saturdays could arrive until morning.#walking #BusanBarstation#southkorea
